answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31849 Country: India Title: We have set time to enter the office from 9.30 to 9.45 if some one enters after 9.45 he is marked late If he or she gets 5 latemarks half day salary is deducted and so on. Question: We have set time to enter the office from 9.30 to 9.45 if some one enters after 9.45 he is marked late If he or she gets 5 latemarks half day salary is deducted and so on. IS IT JAYAZ/HALAL according to shariya?. Answer ID: 31849 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1007/566/D=1432) It is lawful to deduct the salary equal to delay in attendance, particularly when the matter of deduction is already cleared in the rules and regulations. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
